 COMMON JUDGMENT

The petitioners have filed these petitions U/s 166 of the Motor vehicles Act claiming compensation for the death of Sri. T Hanumantharayappa and injuries sustained by Smt.Sangivarathanamma in a motor vehicle accident that occurred on 11-11-2023.
2. The petition averments in brief are as under:

On 11-11-2023 at about 9.30 p.m., the deceased in MVC 226/2024 was riding the motor cycle bearing No.
AP.02.BS.8977 along with the petitioner in MVC Sangivarathnamma vs Chakali Sreenivasulu on 6 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/59778912/
2 No.225/2024 as a pillion rider on the extreme left side of the road near Rahamathpura circle, in front of HDFC bank, at that time the driver of Bolero Goods Vehicle bearing No. AP.02.TB.5979 which was towing a tractor trolley and the driver of the said goods vehicle driven the  SCCH-17 4 MVC No.226/2024 C/w 225/2024 same at high speed, in a rash and negligent manner and dashed the motor cycle of the deceased and caused the accident. Due to the impact, both the rider and the pillion rider fell down on the road and sustained grievous injuries.

Immediately after the accident, the deceased in MVC No.226/2024 was shifted to Teja hospital, Hindupur wherein he took initial treatment and succumbed to the accident injuries on the way to the hospital at Bangalore.
Thereafter postmortem was conducted at District hospital, Hindupur, handed over the body to the petitioners and they have performed funeral and obsequies by spending an amount of Rs.3,00,000/-.
The deceased T Hanumantharayappa was working as Grama Postal Assistant at Indian Postal department and earning Rs.21,000/- p.m.

Due to the untimely death of deceased,
the petitioners have suffered mentally and physically,
they have lost their bread earner.

While determining the compensation this court has to look into the pain and sufferings, medical expenses, diet, food, nourishment, attendant and conveyance charges and loss of amenities and enjoyment  SCCH-17 26 MVC No.226/2024 C/w 225/2024 of life that the PW-1 has suffered, which are discussed herein below:
(A) TOWARDS PAIN AND SUFFERINGS:
